name: ML Model Selection Expansion Inventory
description: Declarative expansion and refinement inventory for reusable Kaggle-style ML pipeline adaptations.

operations.name: Insert Recommended Preprocessing
operations.intent: Insert scaling or power transformation before the estimator when diagnostics recommend it.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a preprocessing step before model training when feature scale or distribution problems are detected, including StandardScaler for numerical data, StandardScaler for numerical features, StandardScaler for numerical logs, and StandardScaler for numerical metadata.

rewrite.before_summary: Features feed the estimator directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A recommended preprocessing stage is inserted before the estimator.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves feature semantics while improving estimator conditioning.

operations.name: Replace Estimator From Recommendation
operations.intent: Select a better estimator class when model-selection diagnostics identify a stronger fit.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Swap the model-training stage for the recommended estimator type.

rewrite.before_summary: A generic estimator stage trains the model.
rewrite.after_summary: The estimator stage is replaced with the recommended sklearn-style estimator.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves the estimator contract while changing the model class.

operations.name: Insert Dimensionality Reduction
operations.intent: Insert PCA or truncated SVD when high-dimensional features are poorly conditioned.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a feature-reduction step before model training when the feature matrix is unstable.

rewrite.before_summary: The estimator consumes the full feature matrix directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A dimensionality-reduction stage is inserted before the estimator.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves downstream prediction semantics while reducing feature instability.

operations.name: Force Cross-Validation Strategy
operations.intent: Use leakage-safe validation when data ordering or grouping requires a specific split strategy.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Force a time-aware or group-aware validation split when ordinary random folds would leak information, including GroupKFold by Patient ID, GroupKFold split by cultivar, GroupKFold split by patient, Stratified GroupKFold, Stratified GroupKFold (Age-based), Stratified GroupKFold by Session ID, 5-fold time-based Cross-Validation, Cross-validation by UserID, and Time-based Cross-Validation.

rewrite.before_summary: Validation may use a generic splitter.
rewrite.after_summary: The validation stage is constrained to the recommended leakage-safe split strategy.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Keeps validation output semantics while preventing invalid train/test leakage.

operations.name: K-Fold Cross-Validated Ensemble
operations.intent: Replace one-shot model training with fold-safe training that produces multiple models and out-of-fold predictions.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Train one model per fold so validation is fair and later stacking can use out-of-fold predictions.

rewrite.before_summary: A single model-training stage feeds prediction or ensembling directly.
rewrite.after_summary: The model-training stage is replaced by fold splitting followed by per-fold model training.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves the train-to-predict contract while adding leakage-safe validation artifacts and out-of-fold predictions.
notes: Use a grouped or time-aware splitter when the planning artifact declares grouped or temporal leakage risk.

uncertainty_notes: This operation changes validation structure but should preserve the downstream prediction contract.

operations.name: Two-Level Stacking
operations.intent: Replace a flat prediction ensemble with a two-level meta-learner over out-of-fold predictions.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use the first-level models' validation predictions as features for a simple second-level model.

rewrite.before_summary: A flat prediction ensemble consumes model outputs directly.
rewrite.after_summary: Out-of-fold predictions are collected into meta-features, a simple meta-learner is trained, and final predictions are produced through that meta-learner.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction output shape while adding a second-level aggregation model.
notes: The meta-learner should remain simple to avoid overfitting the stacking layer.

uncertainty_notes: This operation is only justified when out-of-fold predictions or diverse level-one models are available.

operations.name: Constraint Injection
operations.intent: Insert explicit verification and correction when predictions must satisfy fairness, decorrelation, or invariance constraints.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether predictions violate a declared constraint and add a correction step when they do.

rewrite.before_summary: Model predictions flow directly into the prediction ensemble.
rewrite.after_summary: A constraint verification stage and correction stage are inserted before ensembling.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction semantics while making constraint satisfaction explicit and auditable.
notes: This operation is appropriate for decorrelation, fairness, and physics-invariance requirements.

uncertainty_notes: Post-hoc correction can trade off leaderboard metric performance against constraint satisfaction.

operations.name: Deep Learning Backbone Substitution
operations.intent: Rewrite manual feature engineering plus shallow model training into pretrained-backbone finetuning.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use a pretrained image, text, or multimodal backbone instead of hand-built features when the modality calls for transfer learning, including EfficientNet, ResNet, DenseNet, Inception, VGG, Swin, DeiT, ConvNeXt, NFNet, and UNet-style backbones.

rewrite.before_summary: Feature engineering feeds a generic model-training stage.
rewrite.after_summary: A pretrained backbone is loaded, finetuned, and optionally evaluated with test-time augmentation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Replaces handcrafted representations with learned transfer representations while preserving downstream prediction artifacts.
notes: This is a topology rewrite, not a small post-processing insertion.

uncertainty_notes: This operation should be gated by modality or an explicit transfer-learning recommendation.

operations.name: Pretrained Backbone Ensemble
operations.intent: Replace single-backbone training with a diverse ensemble of pretrained CNN, transformer, and segmentation backbones.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Train and blend multiple pretrained backbones such as EfficientNet (B4-B7) ensemble, EfficientNet-B0 to B4 ensemble, EfficientNet-B2 and DenseNet121 ensemble, EfficientNet-B5 and B6 ensemble, EfficientNet-B7 and DeiT ensemble, ResNet, Inception, VGG, Swin, ConvNeXt, NFNet, or UNet variants.

rewrite.before_summary: One model-training path feeds predictions.
rewrite.after_summary: Multiple pretrained backbones are finetuned and their predictions are blended.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction semantics while adding architecture diversity across transfer-learning backbones.
notes: This covers recurring EfficientNet, ResNet, DenseNet, Inception, VGG, Swin, DeiT, ConvNeXt, NFNet, and UNet ensemble gaps.

operations.name: Heterogeneous Tree Ensemble Blend
operations.intent: Replace a single estimator with a LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost, ExtraTrees, RandomForest, or SVR blend when mined solution deltas require heterogeneous tree ensembling.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Train and blend multiple tree models such as LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost, ExtraTrees, RandomForest, or SVR, including XGBoost and Random Forest ensemble, Random Forest and ExtraTrees ensemble, Random Forest and SVR ensemble, and Random Forest and XGBoost ensemble.

rewrite.before_summary: A single estimator or flat model-training stage produces predictions.
rewrite.after_summary: Multiple heterogeneous tree estimators are trained and their predictions are blended.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction output semantics while adding model diversity for tabular competitions.

operations.name: Permutation Importance Feature Selection
operations.intent: Insert permutation-importance feature selection before estimator training.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Rank features by validation permutation importance and train on the retained subset.

rewrite.before_summary: All engineered features feed estimator training.
rewrite.after_summary: Permutation importance selects a smaller validated feature subset before estimator training.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves estimator inputs while reducing low-value or noisy features.

operations.name: Balanced Rare-Class Sampling
operations.intent: Insert over-sampling or balanced sampling before training when rare classes need more representation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Balance rare classes or rare species before model training so the learner sees enough minority examples.

rewrite.before_summary: Training consumes the original class distribution.
rewrite.after_summary: Training consumes a balanced or over-sampled class distribution.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves labels and feature semantics while changing sample frequency.

operations.name: Pseudo-Labeling Loop
operations.intent: Insert pseudo-label generation and confidence filtering before retraining.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Generate pseudo-labels for unlabeled regions, unlabeled images, test-set data, external datasets, scraped data, or domain-adaptation data, then retrain on high-confidence labels.

rewrite.before_summary: Only labeled training data feeds estimator training.
rewrite.after_summary: High-confidence pseudo-labeled examples are added before estimator training.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves target semantics while expanding training supervision.

operations.name: Iterative Imputation
operations.intent: Insert chained-model imputation for missing values before estimator training.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use Iterative Imputation for missing data, missing markers, or missing values before training.

rewrite.before_summary: Missing values flow into estimator training or basic preprocessing.
rewrite.after_summary: Missing values are iteratively imputed before estimator training.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves feature columns while filling missing entries with model-based estimates.

operations.name: Feature Hashing
operations.intent: Insert the hashing trick for high-cardinality sparse features.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use Feature Hashing or the Hashing Trick for high-cardinality categorical, ad, click-through-rate, or text-like sparse features.

rewrite.before_summary: High-cardinality features feed estimator training through ordinary encoding.
rewrite.after_summary: High-cardinality features are hashed into a fixed sparse feature space.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves sparse feature signal while bounding feature dimensionality.

operations.name: Boosted Tree Early Stopping
operations.intent: Insert early-stopping validation for LightGBM or XGBoost training.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use XGBoost early stopping or LightGBM early stopping to select the best validation iteration.

rewrite.before_summary: Boosted trees train for a fixed number of iterations.
rewrite.after_summary: Boosted trees stop at the best validation iteration.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction semantics while constraining training duration by validation performance.

operations.name: Database Augmentation
operations.intent: Insert retrieval database augmentation before final search or ranking.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use Database Augmentation (DBA) to smooth or diffuse retrieval database embeddings before final ranking.

rewrite.before_summary: Retrieval embeddings feed final search or output directly.
rewrite.after_summary: Retrieval embeddings are augmented with database-neighbor evidence before final search or output.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves retrieval identity while smoothing database representations.

operations.name: Prompt Reasoning Augmentation
operations.intent: Insert chain-of-thought or prompt-reasoning augmentation for LLM-style tasks.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use Chain-of-Thought data augmentation, Chain-of-Thought prompting, or prompt-based CoT traces before training or inference.

rewrite.before_summary: Prompts or examples feed the model without explicit reasoning traces.
rewrite.after_summary: Prompts or examples are augmented with reasoning traces before modeling.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves answer targets while adding intermediate reasoning supervision or prompting context.

operations.name: Metric-Aligned Objective
operations.intent: Replace generic model training with a loss or objective aligned to the leaderboard metric.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use a custom objective such as quantile loss, RMSLE/RMSE-aligned loss, partial AUC weighting, Brier score, Pearson correlation, or F1-weighted loss.

rewrite.before_summary: Model training uses the default estimator objective.
rewrite.after_summary: Model training is configured with a custom objective aligned to the target leaderboard metric.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction output shape while changing the optimization target.

operations.name: Metric-Optimized Thresholding
operations.intent: Insert threshold calibration when class or label decisions are scored by Macro F1, MCC, or related discrete metrics.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Tune prediction thresholds for metrics such as Macro F1, MCC, tag F1, or per-label F1 before formatting the submission.

rewrite.before_summary: Probabilities or raw scores flow directly to output formatting.
rewrite.after_summary: Thresholds are calibrated against the competition metric before final labels are emitted.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction targets while converting scores to decisions with metric-aware thresholds.

operations.name: Retrieval Re-Ranking
operations.intent: Insert local-feature or pairwise-model reranking after first-pass retrieval predictions.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Rerank candidate matches with DELF deep local features or an XGBoost-style pair ranker.

rewrite.before_summary: First-pass retrieval candidates flow directly to output formatting.
rewrite.after_summary: Candidates are reranked with local-feature matching or a pairwise ranking model.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves candidate identity while reordering predictions with stronger pair evidence.

operations.name: Recursive Feature Elimination
operations.intent: Insert RFE before estimator training when solution deltas call for recursive feature selection.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Select a compact feature subset with Recursive Feature Elimination before training the model.

rewrite.before_summary: All engineered features feed estimator training.
rewrite.after_summary: Recursive Feature Elimination selects a smaller feature subset before estimator training.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves estimator inputs while reducing feature noise and redundancy.

operations.name: Log Target Transformation
operations.intent: Insert log1p target scaling for skewed regression targets and invert predictions after inference.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Train on a log-transformed target when the target distribution is strongly skewed, then transform predictions back.

rewrite.before_summary: The estimator trains directly on the raw regression target.
rewrite.after_summary: The target is log-transformed for training and predictions are inverse-transformed.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves final target units while improving training stability for skewed targets.

operations.name: Smoothed Target Encoding
operations.intent: Insert fold-aware mean target encoding with Bayesian smoothing for high-cardinality categorical features.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Encode categories by smoothed target means without leaking validation targets into training folds.

rewrite.before_summary: Categorical variables feed the estimator through generic encoding.
rewrite.after_summary: Categorical variables are encoded with leakage-safe smoothed target means.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves feature-table shape while adding target-aware categorical signal.

audit.rationale: Normalizes the existing ML skeleton expansion CDGs into the provider expansion asset schema consumed by the shared expansion engine.
audit.dejargonized_summary: Reusable ML pipeline changes such as k-fold training, stacking, constraints, and pretrained backbones now use the same expansion schema as other provider operations.

migration_readiness.rationale: The operations are now declared through data/expansions and backed by matcher runtime rules.

uncertainty_notes: The legacy skeleton expansion CDGs remain as source material until all downstream readers consume ExpansionFamilyAsset directly.
